title: Native Carry C3 Crosswalk
description: Lean 4 formalization of the exact native real-to-C3 coordinate crosswalk, enriched TFVD and Green transport, and the global relational bracket route. Version 0.3.0 adds the multiplicity-independent analytic-order reduction, the canonical finite C3 spectral certificate, the exact no-go theorem for the raw positive scalar Cauchy readout, and the polarized two-variable raw C3 Green--gamma identity. The completed trace identity remains an explicit open gate; no unconditional global confinement theorem is promoted.
